Messi with Argentina was never just a player wearing the number 10 shirt. It was an entire story, a story that lasted for generations. From the tears of 2014, the heartbreaks of the finals, and the moments when it seemed that international glory would always remain out of his reach, to the night he finally lifted the Copa América in 2021, and then the greatest moment of his career when he lifted the World Cup in 2022. He fought for this shirt for more than two decades. He carried the pressure, faced the criticism, endured the heartbreak, and eventually became the leader who guided Argentina back to glory. And in 2026, he reached another World Cup final with Argentina before announcing his retirement from international football at the age of 39. Now, only the farewell remains… the final time we will see Messi wear the Argentina shirt, the final time we will see him stand alongside his teammates as their captain, and the final time we will hear the fans chant the name of the man who gave them memories that will live forever. His international career may come to an end, but Messi’s story with Argentina never will. From a young boy carrying impossible dreams… to the captain who lifted the World Cup. From the tears… to glory. From years of waiting… to immortality. Thank you for everything, Leo. 🇦🇷🐐 You were, and always will be, a part of Argentina’s history forever. #messi
